headline: CCTV Operator

experience.title: CCTV Operator
bullets: Monitor 120 CCTV cameras across a sugar mill, warehouses and staff housing.
Alert guards and the security supervisor to intrusions, fights and fires, and guide them by radio.
Coordinate with fire and rescue teams during incidents and log each response.
Protect recorded footage and passwords so only authorised staff can access them.
Encode incident reports and daily logs into the security system.

experience.title: Security Guard
bullets: Guarded a bank branch entrance and kept the visitor log.
Patrolled the premises at night and reported incidents.

summary: CCTV operator with three years monitoring a sugar mill complex in Negros Occidental. I watch and control camera systems, alert and guide guards during incidents, coordinate emergency responses and keep footage and incident records secure.
